summary: Iteration 10 — Settings screen + doc screens + PATCH /api/account + DELETE /api/tutor/history. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (test_iteration_10_settings.py). Frontend: Profile → settings-row navigates to /settings; both groups render (Privacy & Data with 10 rows, Preferences with 2 rows); all expected testIDs present (settings-back, row-privacy, row-terms, row-disclaimer, row-ai, row-market, row-export, row-correct, row-clear-chat, row-contact, row-delete, row-language, row-logout). Docs (terms/ai/market/correct) render correctly and localize to DE ('Nutzungsbedingungen', 'Einstellungen', 'Datenschutz & Daten') and ES ('Transparencia de IA'). Correct My Data: input + save works end-to-end — button label flips to 'Saved' and profile-name updates to the new value. Download My Data opens export JSON modal and export-close dismisses it. Privacy Contact row shows 'privacy@qapilo.app'. Regression: profile still shows stats/watchlist/badges/pro-trial banner.

integration_issues.flow: Clear AI Chat History & Delete Account confirm dialogs on web preview
integration_issues.issue: React Native Alert.alert with multiple buttons does not render any dialog on Expo web (known RN Web limitation) — clicking row-clear-chat / row-delete produces no visible confirm and no destructive action fires on web. Underlying API endpoints work (verified via pytest). Should work fine on native iOS/Android; not a code defect in this feature.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: if E2E web confirm of destructive rows is desired, consider a cross-platform confirm shim (e.g., window.confirm on web) for row-clear-chat and row-delete. Native flow is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/account and DELETE /api/tutor/history are correctly registered on the /api router BEFORE app.include_router(api) — verified in server.py (lines 1252, 1263, 1270).
PATCH /api/account trims whitespace and truncates to 60 chars; empty payload correctly returns 400 with localized message.
settings.tsx cleanly composes Row primitives with testIDs; no HTML tags, all text wrapped in <Text>, StyleSheet.create used.
doc.tsx uses KeyboardAvoidingView for the Correct My Data input; save is disabled while pending and shows 'Saved' state after success.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users created via UI signup (uitest_*@example.com) and via pytest (_signup fixture). pytest fixture deletes its user on teardown; UI test users remain but are harmless (name overridden to 'Corrected UI Name' / 'Regressor').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend signup requires a deliverable domain (pydantic EmailStr rejects '@qapilo.test' etc.); use '@example.com' for TEST_ prefixed accounts. pytest.ini adds xdist by default — pass -o addopts='' when needed. Alert.alert with multiple buttons is a no-op on Expo web — do not rely on it in web-only tests; test destructive flows via the backend endpoints directly.
